variants.name: 暖赭金
variants.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand / hand-lettering refinement.
Input image 1 is the current original logo and composition reference. Create a MORE BRUSH-WRITTEN rendition of these exact FIVE simplified Chinese characters: upper row “逆转”, lower row “五丈原”. Keep the chosen dense nearly-square two-row arrangement, big black top pair, substantial gold bottom trio, both rows about equal width, the flowing 辶 stroke of 逆 bridges the gap. Preserve recognizability and correct character construction, particularly the 车+专 parts of 转. Do not turn it into a horizontal title or reduce 五丈原 to a subtitle.
The specific requested change is significantly stronger CHINESE BRUSH CALLIGRAPHY THROUGHOUT, at ordinary viewing size. Repaint the forms with a large calligraphy brush pulled over dry paper, then extract only the painted marks. The current reference is still too solid and thick-paint-like. Make all five letters visibly hand-written in semi-cursive 行书: flexible tapering turns, forceful pressure changes, abrupt releases, split-bristle ends. The broad strokes open into several clear long transparent unpainted streaks running in the actual stroke direction. Use deliberate calligraphic 飞白 and 枯笔, not random speckle/grunge applied over solid shapes. About a fifth of broad-stroke area may open into directional fine-to-coarse negative-space channels; retain dense dark cores and intact strokes for readability. Natural broken side edges, dry bristle tufts and subtle ink bleeding; no regular outline, knife-cut slabs or chunky smooth vector contours. Lower 五丈原 must be JUST AS visibly brush-written as upper 逆转. It must look like mineral pigment calligraphy, not oil paint or sculpted metal. No relief or thickness on any letter.
Let the top pair finish freely to left and right, with the brush lifting into thin irregular tips; keep the compact silhouette, modest extensions only, no huge symmetrical wings. Slightly varied character angles and height, not rigid geometry. Keep the original recognizable arrangement without tracing its exact rigid contour.
Color: 逆转 overwhelmingly matte carbon black with occasional thin ochre-gold dry-brush threads, and very restrained dark cinnabar at a couple of ending strokes. Gold accents should be less dominant than reference. 五丈原 is warm ochre gold (dominant #C89B36, deeper #926329, lighter #E2C164), flat mineral-gold ink with natural uneven pigment loading; bristle streaks of pale golden yellow and raw ochre, restrained dark cinnabar red near a few tips. Clearly warm gold without glossy bevel or lighting. No dark border on the gold letters. Color variation follows actual brush movement, not a generic top-bottom gradient.
One standalone production logo on genuinely transparent alpha, including all gaps and dry-brush openings. No background, black rectangle, paper, grid or checkerboard. Canvas ratio about 1.2:1 with 6% clear margin on ALL sides, no cropped stroke tips. No captions, labels, seal, frame, crest, emblem, signature, watermark or additional letters. Bespoke lettering, not a named font or existing game logo.
